Experimental and DFT studies indicate that additions of Ta, Ti, Nb, Hf, and Ni are effective in simultaneously increasing both the phase stability and stacking fault energy ofγ′-Co3(Al,W), thus improving the high-temperature strength of Co-base γ′phase and γ + γ′two-phase superalloys by enhancing the ﬂow stress anomalies and the shear resistance of the γ′phase.
